name: ai-fix-runner
description: Local AI Fix Runner — Test 1 of a coding-agent benchmark. Designed so the runner can later be swapped for Tensorlake Sandbox.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/shared run test --if-present && npm --workspace apps/api run test
